subject: WITHDRAW the gate from af21aa8f - mpi-release already stops on the manifest diff. One line of context is all that is left
body:
CORRECTION to af21aa8f - do NOT add the gate I asked for. The user pointed out that promote already lives in the release skill, and he is right. .claude/skills/mpi-release/SKILL.md line 54 already diffs dev vs stable manifests and, on a sha mismatch, STOPS and asks the user to either promote or confirm the dev runtime is deliberately not shipping. It explicitly never auto-promotes. So the enforcement I asked you to add to MPI-450 exists, and a second gate would be duplicate process.

WHAT ACTUALLY SURVIVES is one line of decision context, not a gate. The skill supplies the prompt but not the consequence: it asks 'promote, or is dev deliberately not shipping?' and someone without this session's context can answer 'not shipping' quite reasonably and cut 1.4 anyway. The shas WILL differ - dev is 0.2.43, stable 0.2.40 - so that stop is going to fire on this release.

If you want anything on MPI-450, make it this one line rather than a gate:
  'When mpi-release stops on the dev/stable manifest diff, the answer is PROMOTE. Dev 0.2.43 is the MiniMax H3 download transport (MPI-491). Declining it ships H3 - a headline 1.4 feature - at 1.66 MB/s, about 10 hours for the ~46GB set, and it will not be reported as a bug because it just looks like a big model.'

Everything else in af21aa8f stands: the GPU number comes before the promote answer, scope is remote/Pod and the six huggingface.co deps only, and the RIFE prebake is a separate non-gating card.

My error was escalating without checking whether the release flow already covered it. Flagging it rather than quietly dropping it, since you may already have started editing MPI-450 on the strength of the first message.
resolution: Resolved 2026-08-10 by mpi-cleanup, on the user's call: leftovers, nobody is using them. The whole thread ran MPI-491 -> MPI-467 and BOTH cards are now done/complete. The one action aimed at a live card (af21aa8f, add a 1.4 gate to MPI-450) was WITHDRAWN by 9805e50a in the same thread, because mpi-release already stops on the manifest diff. Nothing here is outstanding.
